## Summary
Create the neo4jQuery tenant-isolated wrapper (C05 resolution) that automatically injects institution_id into every Cypher query, with graceful degradation when Neo4j is unavailable, preventing raw neo4j-driver imports project-wide.

## User story
As a developer, I want a single neo4jQuery function that enforces tenant isolation, so that I never accidentally query or write data across institutional boundaries.

## Why this matters
Without tenant isolation, a Cypher query from Institution A could read or modify Institution B's knowledge graph. This is a FERPA violation and a data integrity catastrophe. C05 was identified as the highest-priority architectural finding. Every downstream story depends on this wrapper existing and being the ONLY way to access Neo4j.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] neo4jQuery(cypher, params, institutionId) injects institution_id into all queries
- [ ] Direct `import { driver } from 'neo4j-driver'` is banned (ESLint rule configured)
- [ ] Direct `import { driver } from './driver'` is banned (ESLint rule configured)
- [ ] neo4jQuery gracefully degrades when Neo4j is unreachable (returns null, logs error)
- [ ] Connection pooling is configured with appropriate max connections
- [ ] Driver is a singleton (not recreated per request)
- [ ] All exports go through packages/neo4j/index.ts barrel

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// packages/neo4j/client.ts — THE canonical pattern (Rule 1)
import { getDriver } from './driver'
import type { QueryResult } from 'neo4j-driver'

export interface Neo4jQueryResult<T = Record<string, unknown>> {
  records: T[]
  summary: { countersUpdated: boolean }
}

export async function neo4jQuery<T = Record<string, unknown>>(
  cypher: string,
  params: Record<string, unknown> = {},
  institutionId: string
): Promise<Neo4jQueryResult<T> | null> {
  const driver = getDriver()
  if (!driver) {
    console.warn('[neo4j] Driver unavailable — graceful degradation')
    return null
  }

  const session = driver.session()
  try {
    // CRITICAL: Always inject institution_id for tenant isolation
    const result = await session.run(cypher, {
      ...params,
      institution_id: institutionId,
    })
    return {
      records: result.records.map(r => r.toObject() as T),
      summary: { countersUpdated: result.summary.counters.containsUpdates() },
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[neo4j] Query failed — graceful degradation:', error)
    return null  // Never throw — Neo4j failure must not block the user (Rule 6)
  } finally {
    await session.close()
  }
}

// packages/neo4j/driver.ts — singleton driver
import neo4j, { Driver } from 'neo4j-driver'

let _driver: Driver | null = null

export function getDriver(): Driver | null {
  if (!process.env.NEO4J_URI) return null
  if (!_driver) {
    _driver = neo4j.driver(
      process.env.NEO4J_URI,
      neo4j.auth.basic(
        process.env.NEO4J_USERNAME!,
        process.env.NEO4J_PASSWORD!
      ),
      { maxConnectionPoolSize: 50, connectionAcquisitionTimeout: 10000 }
    )
  }
  return _driver
}

// packages/neo4j/index.ts — barrel export (public API)
export { neo4jQuery } from './client'
export type { Neo4jQueryResult } from './client'
// NOTE: driver.ts is NOT exported — internal only
```

// ✗ Throwing on Neo4j failure — blocks the user (Rule 6 violation)

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E01/E01-S02.infra.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

test('Acceptance: neo4jQuery injects institution_id', async () => {
  // Import the wrapper
  const { neo4jQuery } = await import('@journey/neo4j/client')

  // Query with institution_id — should inject automatically
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (n {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(n) as count',
    {},
    'test-institution-001'
  )

  // If Neo4j is available, result should not be null
  // If unavailable, graceful degradation returns null
  if (result) {
    expect(result.records).toBeDefined()
    expect(Array.isArray(result.records)).toBe(true)
  } else {
    // Graceful degradation — this is acceptable
    expect(result).toBeNull()
  }
})

test('Acceptance: driver is singleton', async () => {
  const { getDriver } = await import('@journey/neo4j/driver')
  const driver1 = getDriver()
  const driver2 = getDriver()
  // Same reference (singleton pattern)
  expect(driver1).toBe(driver2)
})

test('Acceptance: graceful degradation on connection failure', async () => {
  // Temporarily unset NEO4J_URI to simulate unavailability
  const originalUri = process.env.NEO4J_URI
  delete process.env.NEO4J_URI

  const { neo4jQuery } = await import('@journey/neo4j/client')
  const result = await neo4jQuery('MATCH (n) RETURN n', {}, 'test-institution')

  // Should return null, not throw
  expect(result).toBeNull()

  // Restore
  process.env.NEO4J_URI = originalUri
})

test('Negative: barrel export does not expose driver', async () => {
  const neo4jPackage = await import('@journey/neo4j')
  expect(neo4jPackage).toHaveProperty('neo4jQuery')
  expect(neo4jPackage).not.toHaveProperty('getDriver')
  expect(neo4jPackage).not.toHaveProperty('driver')
})
```
